errors.description: Typo in the Type B case: the write-up writes ℓ = m+n, but ℓ = lcm(m,n)/gcd(m,n) = mn when gcd = 1. The conclusion drawn ((m,n) ↦ (1, mn), product unchanged, ℓ > 1) is correct and Step 2 uses ℓ = mn correctly, so the slip is harmless.
errors.quote: Then $\ell = m+n \ge 2\cdot 2 = 4 > 1$, so the pair $(m,n)$ is replaced by $(1, mn)$

parsed.notes: Termination via (product, number of ones) with explicit bound; exactly-one via 'no move creates two 1s'. Part (b) via the per-prime invariant gcd of p-adic valuations, with the zero-tuple case handled and the terminal position read off correctly. Complete and correct; only a cosmetic typo.
